body.name: canonical finite graph computations
body.construction:
All graphs \(G\) in these computations are the derived observed latent-projection LS-ADMMG/CADMG \(G_H^{[]}\) stored in the input, or current CADMGs mechanically obtained from it. For a CADMG \(G\) and a sequence \(\pi=(W_1,\ldots,W_k)\), let \(\operatorname{valid}_G(\pi)\) recursively check, in the graph obtained after fixing \(W_1,\ldots,W_{i-1}\), that
\[
 \operatorname{dis}(W_i)\cap\operatorname{de}(W_i)=\{W_i\}
 \quad (i=1,\ldots,k).
\]
For \(T\subseteq\operatorname{random}(G)\), \(\operatorname{fixSeq}_G(T)\) enumerates all permutations having support exactly \(T\), retains the valid ones, and returns the least one under the input encoding, or \(\operatorname{none}\).  Put
\[
 \operatorname{reachable}_G(R)
 \Longleftrightarrow
 \operatorname{fixSeq}_G\{\operatorname{random}(G)\setminus R\}
 \ne\operatorname{none}.
\]
For \(D\subseteq\operatorname{random}(G)\), \(\operatorname{closure}_G(D)\) enumerates all reachable \(C\supseteq D\), selects an inclusion-minimal member, and uses the encoding only to break a tie.  For \(s\in H\), define \(\operatorname{laidback}(s,D)\) to mean that every \(X\in D\) is either not selector controlled or has intervention-status coordinate zero at \(s\), and define
\[
 \operatorname{seriousSet}(s,B)
 =\{X\in B\cap\operatorname{ch}(S):s_X^e=1\}.
\]
Compatibility with \(a_{\operatorname{spa}(D^{*})}\) requires every selector-forced coordinate in \(A\cap\operatorname{spa}(D^{*})\) to equal its coordinate in \(a\).  The context graph \(G[s]\) is computed by deleting every labelled edge whose label contains a variable in \(\operatorname{seriousSet}\{s,\operatorname{ch}(S)\}\), erasing the remaining labels, and deduplicating edges.  Ancestors, descendants, nondescendants, strict parents, districts, support, compatibility, and d-separation are computed on the resulting finite graph.
